01 / THE APPROACHA SEASON, SEEN FROM ABOVE

Three flights.
One complete picture.

Yield doesn’t happen in a moment. It unfolds over a season. By connecting three growth stages, we see the patterns a single image can miss.

03 / THE SCIENCE INSIDE

From pixels
to possibility.

Every prediction is a chain of considered decisions. Here’s how a view from above becomes a number you can work with.

IMAGERYINTELLIGENCE
FIVE STEPS. ONE CONNECTED SYSTEM.
01
KEEP THE PICTURE TOGETHER

Split by plot.

All three flights of each plot stay in the same split. Model 1 uses 1,489 training, 319 validation and 323 test plots.

No timepoint leakage
02
MAKE EVERY PIXEL COUNT

Prepare the patches.

Plot images become 224 × 224 patches. Replication padding preserves the image edges and outperformed the benchmarked alternatives.

224 × 224 px
03
SEE BENEATH THE SURFACE

Extract what matters.

A fine-tuned EfficientNet-B0 extracts patch embeddings, paired with twelve canopy indices at each of the three timepoints.

Vision + vegetation signals
04
LESS NOISE. MORE SIGNAL.

Refine the features.

Pedigree, spatial context, prototype similarity and mRMR selection retain 113 features for Model 1 and 77 domain-invariant features for Model 2.

113 / 77 selected features
05
BRING IT ALL TOGETHER

Predict with perspective.

Model 1 blends XGBoost, ExtraTrees, HistGB and Ridge across three feature views. Model 2 combines a physical anchor with a within-field ranker.

Yield · rank · quality flags
04 / TWO WAYS TO SEE FURTHERCOMPLEMENTARY BY DESIGN

Known ground.
New horizons.

One model learns the fields it knows. The other is tested on a field it has never seen. Different jobs. An honest view of performance.
